# Security

If you find a way to read or change someone else's notebook, take over an account or token, or anything else that puts people's data at risk, please report it privately:

**[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/thehamish555/survival-notebook/security/advisories/new)**

Please don't open a public issue for it. You'll get a reply as soon as possible, and a fix goes out to the website, the API and the mod together.

Only the newest version of the mod and the live website are supported.
